hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative two, three and zero, negative three. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative two, three to zero, three that is labeled two. There is a vertical dotted segment from zero, three to zero, negative three that is labeled negative six.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-3$.
